page.content:
Inoki disciple and early IWGP Heavyweight Champion.

How Tatsumi Fujinami connects

  • Character: Antonio Inoki — Fujinami was an Inoki disciple who carried Strong Style into the 1980s.
  • Item: IWGP World Heavyweight Championship — Fujinami's early IWGP Heavyweight reigns preceded the modern world-title lineage.

What is Tatsumi Fujinami?

Tatsumi Fujinami was among Inoki's first stars, a Dragon who held the early IWGP Heavyweight Championship and carried Strong Style into the 1980s national era.

Key threads lead to Antonio Inoki and IWGP World Heavyweight Championship.
